title: UniT: Toward a Unified Physical Language for Human-to-Humanoid Policy Learning and World Modeling
version_note: arXiv reports v2 adds ancillary citation file; manuscript unchanged

release_status.value: Data preparation, tokenizer and VLA training/GR1 evaluation available; 3B few-shot/full-data model and tokenizer safetensors listed on Hugging Face. WM-UniT and real-world deployment stack pending.

evidence_boundaries: Main experiments use paired visual/action demonstrations, not arbitrary unannotated internet video
VLA action expert conditions on shared visual-language context and proprioception, not argmax token IDs
WM uses continuous pre-quantization action-branch features
WM cross-embodiment video generation is not real robot action execution
Real robot experiments use proprietary pretraining data; w/o human labels do not establish no human data in full training history
Figure 11 UniT w/o human combinatorial result is 20 percent; prose says 10 percent
Few-shot articulated performance drops from 56.7 to 51.7 percent after human co-training
Zero-shot stacking is 6/10 and absent only from robot demonstrations, present in human demonstrations
t-SNE overlap is supporting visualization, not proof of embodiment invariance
WM and VLA are separately evaluated; integrated planning/RL is future work
DROID FVD slightly worse than raw action
Real-world deployment stack and WM code not yet released
